test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

They have decorated the hall beautifully.

options.text: The hall was decorated beautifully by them.
The hall is decorated beautifully by them.
The hall is being decorated beautifully by them.
The hall has been decorated beautifully by them

solution:
The correct answer is "**The hall has been decorated beautifully by them**"
